headline: Silver Prices Fall Below Key Threshold Amid Rate-Hike Concerns
summary: A steep market sell-off pushed silver below Rs 2 lakh per kilogram, wiping out earlier gains as higher energy costs and rate-hike concerns weighed on the metal.
why: Precious metals serve as traditional hedges against inflation and currency debasement, making rapid price swings vital for commodity traders and industrial users.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Higher interest rate expectations increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding precious metals.

why_moved: Broader macroeconomic concerns regarding central bank interest rate hikes and rising energy costs triggered heavy liquidation in the silver market.
